title: alchemilla hybrida subsp. plicata
intro: Alchemilla hybrida subsp. plicata, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide health benefits such as soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and supporting wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Lady's Mantle include astringency, which helps to reduce bleeding and inflammation, and vulnerary properties, which promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
